note: Acceptance criteria for the thermal controller, written from the symptoms seen on the oven (slow warm-up, stopping short of SP, overshoot, no recovery). PROPOSED values: the owner must confirm them. They are checked on the two-node digital twin (simulation), never on a real oven.

criteria.what: first batch from 33 C: seconds until the air reaches SP - 0.3 C
overshoot above SP after reaching it
dip below SP after reaching it
samples in the High alarm band
last hour of the first batch within +-0.1 C of SP
door opens (-3 C): seconds until the air is back within 0.3 C of SP for good
last hour after the door: no oven stays stuck below SP
